content_sections.heading: NPCC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for NPCC Recruitment 2026 is based on educational qualification, post-qualification experience, and age limit, which vary by post. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. All qualifications must be full-time/part-time and regular/distance mode from a University/Institution recognized by UGC/AICTE, or an Indian/foreign University/Institution granted equivalence/recognition by AIU. Except for CA and CMA, the essential qualification for posts other than Executive Director (Engg.) and Dy. Manager (Law) should be of minimum two years' duration. For Dy. Manager (Law), the Graduate in Law at Bar must be a 3-year course after graduation or a 5-year course after Class 12. NPCC will decide the equivalence of qualifications at its discretion. The notification specifies detailed conditions for how this experience is counted, depending on whether the candidate is working in a regular cadre/contractual pay scale role or on consolidated remuneration, in government, semi-government, PSU, autonomous body, or non-government/private sector organizations. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for the exact next-below pay scale or CTC equivalence required for each post, as this varies by position. Post-qualification experience must be in the relevant field, and experience is counted only from the date of declaration of the result, or the date of issue of the final year mark sheet/provisional certificate/degree of the essential qualification, whichever is earliest, up to the cut-off date.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor in Engineering or equivalent. Post Graduate Management/M.Tech. preferred.
MBA/Post Graduate Degree/Post Graduate Diploma with specialization in HR/Personnel Management
Graduate in Law at Bar. Additional Post Graduate in Law preferred.

For internal candidates, age is not a bar. The cut-off date for determining the upper age limit is 31.07.2026.

content_sections.heading: NPCC Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: As per the notification, the selection procedure will be decided by NPCC depending on the response received against the above posts. The selection criteria may be by way of a Personal Interview or by any other appropriate method, at the discretion of NPCC. The final selection will be based on performance in the interview (or the alternate method used), after which the "Offer of Appointment" will be issued. The selected candidate will be on probation for one year. The notification does not specify a separate written exam or skill test stage.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NPCC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the following documents at the time of submitting the online application, in support of their eligibility for the post: Matriculation/Secondary Certificate/Birth Certificate as proof of date of birth Complete set of mark sheets/degree certificate in support of qualification and/or specialization, as applicable Proof of post-qualification experience indicating date of joining, date of relieving, pay scales/CTC, etc., for each position held Pay-in-slip of the latest month Latest Form-16 of the last two financial years (if applicable) Category certificate in the prescribed Government of India format (if applicable) Disability certificate in the prescribed format, issued by a Competent Authority (if applicable) Income and Asset Certificate for EWS reservation, as per prescribed format (if applicable) Aadhar Card and any other supporting documents All uploaded documents must be in legible condition. Incomplete application forms or insufficient documents may be rejected. NPCC may also ask for additional documents at a later stage, to be sent by post or email as instructed.

faq.question: Q1. What is NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NPCC Recruitment 2026 refers to the recruitment drive by National Projects Construction Corporation Limited to fill 26 regular vacancies for the posts of Executive Director (Engg.), Joint General Manager (Finance), Manager (Finance), Manager (HR), Dy. Manager (Finance), and Dy. Manager (Law) through Advertisement No. NPCC/Regular/Engg./Finance/HR/Law/Jul./2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 26 vacancies (current/backlog) are available across six posts: Executive Director (Engg.) - 1, Joint General Manager (Finance) - 1, Manager (Finance) - 4, Manager (HR) - 5, Dy. Manager (Finance) - 11, and Dy. Manager (Law) - 4.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for NPCC Recruitment 2026 is 22nd August 2026, till 11:59 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post and range from a Bachelor's degree in Engineering (for Executive Director), CA/CMA/MBA(Finance) (for finance posts), MBA/PG Degree/PG Diploma in HR (for Manager HR), to a Graduate in Law at Bar (for Dy. Manager Law). Full details are given in the Educational Qualification section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit ranges from 30 years (Dy. Manager posts) to 53 years (Executive Director), depending on the post. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST, OBC(NCL), PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NPCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for General and OBC candidates. There is no fee for SC/ST/PwBD/EWS/Ex-Servicemen candidates. Payment must be made through the online payment gateway only.
